chunks: From him, from Ibn Faddal, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jahm, from Dharih, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'When the juice ferments or boils, it becomes forbidden.'
ai.seo_question: When does grape juice become forbidden to drink according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadi’ (AS) to define the precise moment grape juice transforms into *khamr*, marking the transition from permissible (*mubah*) to forbidden (*haram*) consumption. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic principle that intoxication, rather than mere fermentation, is the decisive factor for prohibition, a concept central to the science of *usul al-fiqh* regarding *naskh* and *takhrij* of rulings.
